messages.author: db582c6760911594
messages.subject: example in "ggplot2 - Elegant Graphics for Data Analysis" gives error
parts:
Hello, this code in the example dataset:

http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/book/toolbox.r

line 55

gives error:

> qplot(carat, depth, data=diamonds, geom="boxplot", group = round_any(carat, 0.1, floor), xlim = c(0, 3))
Error in if (any(diff(intervals) < -1e-06)) { :
missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
>

me not understand :)

Thanx, Radek

>   missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

Same here (ggplot 0.8.3, R 2.9.1). "xlim" seems to be the problem;
these work:

> qplot(carat, depth, data=diamonds, geom="boxplot", group = round_any(carat, 0.1, floor))
> qplot(carat, depth, data=diamonds, geom="boxplot", group = round_any(carat, 0.1, floor)) + coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,3))

I tried debugging with option(error=recover), but couldn't find my way
around the 21-level-deep call stack.

Regards,
Jon Olav
